title: Tonkotsu Ramen
description: A Japanese-inspired pork bone broth ramen with a rich, savory flavor. This comforting dish is perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Bring the tonkotsu to a boil in a large pot over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the soy sauce over medium heat.
Add the snow peas and peas to the pan and cook until tender.
To assemble the ramen, place a portion of noodles in a bowl, followed by a spoonful of the tonkotsu and a sprinkle of peas.
